answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 16 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 420 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The karst keeps the gate honest, the pigment keeps the farm poor, and the fable keeps the honest agent paid.
